name: Symrise AG
tagline: Global leader in fragrances, flavorings, cosmetic active ingredients and functional ingredients
hero_kpi_rationale: La guidance de marge EBITDA 2026 de 21,5% à 22,5% (ajustée) démontre la capacité de Symrise à maintenir une profitabilité robuste tout en réinvestissant les gains d'efficacité dans la croissance, reflétant l'exécution de la stratégie One Symrise et les ~100M€ d'économies cumulées en 2024-2025.

kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization as a percentage of sales, management guidance for full year 2026 on an adjusted basis.
kpis.signal: Management confidence in maintaining robust profitability through operational efficiency gains and disciplined capital allocation.
kpis.description: EBITDA margin guidance for FY 2026 is 21.5% - 22.5% (adjusted basis), demonstrating management's confidence in sustained profitability.
kpis._hero_history_unverified_reason: Le KPI 'FY 2026 EBITDA Margin Guidance' n'est pas présent dans le rapport annuel 2025 fourni. Le document contient uniquement les marges EBI

kpis.explanation: Year-on-year growth in revenue excluding foreign exchange and portfolio effects, management guidance for full year 2026.
kpis.signal: Expected improvement in organic sales growth through favorable comparables, market share gains, and healthy innovation pipeline.
kpis.description: Organic sales growth guidance for FY 2026 is 2% - 4%, expected to improve as year progresses supported by favorable year-on-year comparables and new product launches.

kpis.explanation: Year-on-year growth in revenue excluding foreign exchange and portfolio effects for the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Q1 2026 impacted by very strong year-on-year comparables and geopolitical uncertainty, expected to improve in subsequent quarters.
kpis.description: Q1 2026 organic sales growth is expected to be down low single-digit, impacted by overall very strong year-on-year comparables particularly in UV Filters and geopolitical uncertainty.

kpis.explanation: Year-on-year growth in revenue excluding foreign exchange and portfolio effects for full year 2025.
kpis.signal: Modest organic growth reflecting macroeconomic headwinds and competitive pressure from Asia, particularly in Aroma Molecules and UV Filters.
kpis.description: Full year 2025 organic sales growth reached 2.8%, with €194m FX headwinds and €16m portfolio effect from divestitures of Aqua Feed and 51% of UK trading business.

kpis.explanation: Year-on-year growth in revenue excluding foreign exchange and portfolio effects for the fourth quarter of 2025.
kpis.signal: Q4 2025 improved momentum with 3.6% organic growth, driven by Scent & Care segment strength, supported by €61m FX headwinds and €3m portfolio effect.
kpis.description: Q4 2025 organic sales growth reached 3.6%, with strong Scent & Care performance (5.5%) offset by Taste, Nutrition & Health slowdown (2.5%).

kpis.name_fr: Cible de croissance organique à moyen terme
kpis.explanation: Compound annual growth rate (CAGR) target for organic sales growth through 2028, reflecting management's long-term growth objectives.
kpis.signal: Mid-term target of 5% - 7% CAGR reflects management confidence in above-market growth driven by market share gains and innovation pipeline.
kpis.description: Mid-term organic sales growth target through 2028 is 5% - 7% CAGR, supported by structural demand drivers, regional customer relationships, and product innovation.

kpis.short: Business Free Cash Flow Margin Target
kpis.name_fr: Marge de flux de trésorerie disponible cible
kpis.name_en: Business Free Cash Flow Margin Target
kpis.explanation: Target for business free cash flow as a percentage of sales, reflecting capital efficiency and financial health.
kpis.signal: Target of >14% adjusted business free cash flow margin for both FY 2026 guidance and mid-term through 2028 demonstrates strong cash generation capability.
kpis.description: Business free cash flow margin target is >14% (adjusted) for FY 2026 guidance and mid-term targets through 2028, supporting disciplined capital allocation priorities.

kpis.name_fr: Cible de marge EBITDA à moyen terme
kpis.explanation: Target EBITDA margin through 2028, reflecting sustainable profitability objectives on a mid-term basis.
kpis.signal: Mid-term EBITDA margin target of 21% - 23% reflects management's commitment to maintaining robust profitability while reinvesting efficiency gains.
kpis.description: Mid-term EBITDA margin target through 2028 is 21% - 23%, supported by ongoing efficiency gains and disciplined capital allocation.

kpis.name_fr: Économies de coûts structurelles et gains d'efficacité cumulés
kpis.name_en: Cumulative Structural Cost Savings and Efficiency Gains (2024-2025)
kpis.explanation: Cumulative structural cost savings and efficiency improvements delivered through the One Symrise transformation program in 2024-2025.
kpis.signal: Cumulative €100m in structural cost savings and efficiency gains in 2024-2025 demonstrates successful execution of One Symrise transformation with portion reinvested in growth.
kpis.description: Symrise delivered cumulative structural cost savings and efficiency gains of approximately €100 million in 2024 and 2025, with focus shifting to growth acceleration in 2026.

kpis.explanation: Authorization amount for inaugural share buyback program, commenced February 2, 2026.
kpis.signal: €400m inaugural share buyback program authorization demonstrates confidence in business outlook and commitment to shareholder returns alongside dividend growth.
kpis.description: Symrise commenced inaugural share buyback program with authorization of €400 million on February 2, 2026, active through October 31, 2026.

kpis.name_fr: Cible de levier financier à long terme
kpis.explanation: Target range for net debt to EBITDA ratio to maintain investment-grade balance sheet strength.
kpis.signal: Long-term leverage target of 1.5x - 2.5x EBITDA reflects commitment to maintaining investment-grade balance sheet with strong liquidity profile.
kpis.description: Symrise targets long-term leverage range of 1.5x - 2.5x EBITDA while maintaining investment-grade balance sheet and strong liquidity position.

kpis.explanation: Target percentage of net income to be returned to shareholders as dividends with absolute annual increases.
kpis.signal: Dividend payout target of 30% - 50% of net income with absolute annual increases demonstrates balanced capital allocation between growth investment and shareholder returns.
kpis.description: Symrise targets return of 30% - 50% of net income to shareholders through dividends with commitment to absolute annual dividend increases.

kpis.explanation: Target capital expenditures as a percentage of sales for mid-term period, reflecting investment in high-return organic growth opportunities.
kpis.signal: Mid-term CapEx target of 4% - 5% of sales reflects disciplined capital allocation prioritizing high-return organic investments to scale existing capabilities.
kpis.description: Mid-term CapEx target is 4% - 5% of sales, focused on high-return investments that scale existing capabilities to augment growth.

kpis.explanation: Percentage of raw material purchases from natural sources, reflecting industry-leading naturals portfolio and low structural oil and gas exposure.
kpis.signal: Approximately 80% of €2bn annual raw material purchases are from natural sources, providing structural resilience against energy price volatility.
kpis.description: Symrise sources approximately 80% of its €2 billion annual raw material purchases from natural materials, reflecting industry-leading naturals portfolio.

kpis.name_en: Direct Energy Expenses as % of Sales
kpis.explanation: Direct energy expenses as a percentage of sales, indicating energy cost efficiency and hedging strategy effectiveness.
kpis.signal: Direct energy expenses of approximately 2.5% of sales in 2025 with key requirements covered through forward fixed-price arrangements provide cost stability.
kpis.description: 2025 direct energy expenses were approximately 2.5% of sales, with significant portion covered through forward fixed-price arrangements.

kpis.explanation: Percentage of group sales derived from Middle East region, indicating geographic concentration risk.
kpis.signal: Middle East sales exposure below 3% of Group sales provides structural resilience to regional geopolitical uncertainties.
kpis.description: Middle East exposure is below 3% of Group sales, providing limited direct exposure to regional geopolitical disruptions.

ai_positioning.summary: Symrise is developing AI capabilities as part of its strategic transformation. The company established a global data and AI hub in Barcelona in 2025 to advance digital capabilities and support speed-to-market initiatives. AI is mentioned as part of reinvestment priorities in efficiency gains and as an enabler of competitive advantage in Fragrance segment operations.
evidence: Opened global data and AI hub in Barcelona in FY 2025 to advance digital capabilities
AI-enabled speed-to-market cited as competitive advantage in Fragrance business
Innovation ecosystem implementation includes digital infrastructure and AI as reinvestment priorities
Organizational improvements and talent recruitment focused on digital and AI capabilities
ai_positioning.source: Symrise Pre-Close Aide-Mémoire Q1 2026, Strategic Commentary and One Symrise Strategy Execution sections

risks.title: Dépendance à des matières premières naturelles
risks.score_rationale: Le risque est mentionné de manière récurrente dans le rapport, avec un langage fort sur la sécurisation des approvisionnements. Il s'agit d'un enjeu structurel pour l'activité Naturals. La catégorie 'Industriel' est centrale pour Symrise.
risks.summary: Symrise dépend fortement de matières premières naturelles comme les agrumes ou les extraits végétaux. Des perturbations climatiques, géopolitiques ou concurrentielles peuvent affecter leur disponibilité et leur coût, notamment pour les produits phares comme les alternatives aux agrumes en Chine.

risks.title: Concurrence accrue en Asie sur les arômes
risks.score_rationale: Le document cite explicitement une intensification de la concurrence en Asie, notamment pour Aroma Molecules. Le langage est direct et préoccupé. Le risque est stable mais central.
risks.summary: Les activités d'Aroma Molecules font face à une concurrence particulièrement vive en Asie, avec des acteurs régionaux offrant des prix agressifs. Cela exerce une pression sur les marges et la part de marché de Symrise dans ce segment stratégique.

risks.title: Pression sur les fragrances grand public
risks.score_rationale: Le rapport note des dynamiques atténuées dans certaines unités, sans alarmisme mais avec vigilance. Le risque est modéré mais réel dans un contexte de consommation plus rationnelle.
risks.summary: Les segments de fragrances grand public, notamment en Europe et Amérique latine, font face à une demande plus volatile et à une concurrence accrue, affectant la croissance malgré une bonne performance globale.

risks.title: Dépendance à des sites de production clés
risks.score_rationale: Le rapport souligne des investissements stratégiques à Grasse, Granada, Holzminden. La concentration géographique des capacités représente un risque opérationnel majeur. Position élevé dans le document.
risks.summary: Symrise a renforcé ses sites clés comme Grasse (France) ou Granada (Espagne) pour les fragrances et les ingrédients cosmétiques. Toute perturbation dans ces usines stratégiques pourrait impacter gravement la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale.

risks.title: Intégration des capacités d'IA dans l'innovation
risks.score_rationale: L'IA est présentée comme un levier stratégique majeur, avec création d'un hub à Barcelone. Le langage est ambitieux mais le risque est lié à l'exécution. Catégorie technologique en montée.
risks.summary: Symrise mise sur l'IA, notamment via Symvision AI™, pour accélérer le développement de formules. Le risque réside dans la capacité à intégrer ces outils à grande échelle tout en préservant l'expertise humaine.

risks.title: Divestissement de business non stratégiques
risks.score_rationale: Les cessions d'Aqua Feed et de Terpenes sont clairement évoquées. Le risque est modéré mais lié à la restructuration du portefeuille. Position importante dans la stratégie ONE Symrise.
risks.summary: La sortie progressive de business non prioritaires comme Aqua Feed ou les Terpènes peut générer des perturbations organisationnelles, des coûts cachés ou des pertes de synergies imprévues.

risks.title: Réglementation croissante sur les ingrédients
risks.score_rationale: Le rapport mentionne l'adaptation aux exigences réglementaires spécifiques, notamment pour les filtres UV. Le risque est élevé et structurel, avec un langage prudent.
risks.summary: Les segments cosmétiques et nutritionnels sont soumis à une réglementation stricte et en évolution, notamment sur les filtres UV ou les additifs alimentaires. Tout changement réglementaire peut nécessiter des reformulations coûteuses.

profit_warning.rationale: Pas de profit warning formel identifié dans les sources analysées (10-K, transcripts). À reconfirmer au prochain earnings call.
profit_warning.margin_trend: Pas de KPI marge disponible pour évaluer la tendance.
